description:
Browse published Bible verse collections. Search by keyword, filter by language, sort by popularity.

Use this when the user looks for Bible verses to memorize on a theme (e.g. hope,
anxiety, forgiveness) or for a ready-made memory list, such as one for a church group.

Collections their publisher keeps out of Discover (`listed` false) are not returned;
get_collection_detail still opens them by id.

Each result includes the collection's raw cover `image` — the URL the publisher
set, or null if they set none (the app may still show an auto-generated cover when
null). This is the stored value, not the computed display image.

language.description: Language code, optionally with a region or script (e.g. "en", "de", "pt-BR", "zh").
language.title: Language

search.description: Search term to filter by name, description, or publisher name.
search.title: Search
